title: 第9章 被发现了第10章 吴厚解围
lines: 总管的话，让小红大吃一惊。
吴谦虽然说过一月之期，但对其他细节，却都是含糊而过，并未提及对食厮混。
不是吴厚今天说起，她都不知道有这盆脏水。
小红连忙摇头否认，目不斜视的说道，
“都是范岱胡说，我只是打坏了桌子，怕受惩罚，所以求吴谦帮忙，除此外再无其他！”
与对食比起来，真相反而无伤大雅，小红全盘托出，希望吴厚了解事实后，收回对吴谦的要求。
吴厚并不理会，缓缓走下榻来，俯身靠近小红，老脸差点就贴上去。
两眼眯成一条缝，冷冷审视着她，仿佛用眼神就能把小红看穿。
“你很关心他？”
压迫感如有实质。
小红再次摇头，坚定否认道，
“没有！”
“没有……你来求什么情？”
“我只是怕您冤枉他，都是因我拖累。”
吴厚终于直起身，两人恢复正常距离，小红松了口气。
吴厚心里清楚，吴谦刚净身气血虚弱，躺了半个月爬不起来，哪有心思对食。
就算有那个心，也没那个力，有那个力也不一定有那个胆。
选择吴谦入宫，看重的就是他老实本分，没花花肠子，又怎会刚来就勾搭宫女。
事实真相如何，对吴厚不重要。
范岱的那些小聪明，逃不过他的眼睛，小动作，也逃不过他的眼线，吴厚一清二楚。
他不是真的不管，他只是在等，等吴谦亲自求他。
这样一来，救命之恩，和坑吴谦净身的亏欠，就能一笔勾销。
到时候恩威并施，还能让吴谦彻底屈服，心甘情愿为自己所用。
所以，吴厚暂时没打算出面干涉，小红求情也无用。
“既然不关心，那就回去吧。”
说完，吴厚重新躺下，眯上双眼送客。
小红几度想再解释，终是没有张口。
吴厚的性子她了解，说过的话从不改变，无论她如何努力都没用。
小红无比失落，小声向吴厚告辞，垂着头向外走去。
走到门口，身后传来吴厚的声音。
“别忘了自己的身份。”
冷漠中带着几分警告。
小红没有回头，只是默默点头，悄然离开。
锅碗瓢盆，外加灶台案板，都被吴谦刷的溜滑干净，整个厨房焕然一新。
吴谦拍了拍手上灰尘，心满意足的赶往下一地点，浇花。
一茬一茬收割着道德值，吴谦的心思又活络起来，开始琢磨系统收益问题。
content_en:
The manager's words surprised Xiao Hong.
Although Wu Qian mentioned the one-month period, he was vague about other details and did not mention eating and hanging out.
If Wu Hou hadn't mentioned it today, she wouldn't have known there was such a basin of dirty water.
Xiaohong quickly shook her head in denial and said without looking away,
"It's all Fan Dai's nonsense. I just broke the table and was afraid of being punished, so I asked Wu Qian for help. Nothing else!"
Compared with the confrontation, the truth is innocuous. Xiaohong tells it all, hoping that Wu Hou will withdraw his request to Wu Qian after he understands the facts.
Wu Hou ignored her, walked slowly to the bed, leaned close to Xiao Hong, and almost touched her face.
He narrowed his eyes to a slit and looked at her coldly, as if he could see through Xiao Hong with his eyes.
"You care about him?"
The feeling of oppression has substance.
Xiaohong shook her head again and firmly denied,
"No!"
"No...what are you asking for?"
"I'm just afraid that you will wrongly accuse him because of me."
Wu Hou finally straightened up, and the two returned to normal distance. Xiao Hong breathed a sigh of relief.
Wu Hou knew in his heart that Wu Qiangang was weak in energy and blood and couldn't get up after lying down for half a month, so he couldn't think about food.
Even if you have the heart, you don’t have the strength, and if you have the strength, you don’t necessarily have the courage.
The reason why Wu Qian was chosen to enter the palace was that he was honest and honest, and he didn't want to be a frivolous person. How could he seduce the palace maids when he first arrived?
The truth is not important to Wu Hou.
Fan Dai's little cleverness cannot escape his eyes, and his little moves cannot escape his eyes. Wu Hou knows it all.
He didn't really care, he was just waiting for Wu Qian to beg him personally.
In this way, the grace of saving his life and the debt of defrauding Wu Qian's body can be written off in one stroke.
When the time comes, the combination of kindness and power can make Wu Qian completely surrender and be willing to be used by him.
Therefore, Wu Hou has no plans to intervene for the time being, and Xiao Hong's plea is useless.
"If you don't care, then go back."
After saying that, Wu Hou lay down again and closed his eyes to see off the guests.
Xiaohong wanted to explain several times, but she finally didn't open her mouth.
She understood Wu Hou's temperament, and his words never changed, no matter how hard she tried, it was useless.
Xiao Hong was extremely disappointed. She said goodbye to Wu Hou in a low voice and walked out with her head lowered.
Walking to the door, Wu Hou's voice came from behind.
"Don't forget who you are."
There was a hint of warning in the indifference.
Xiaohong didn't look back, just nodded silently and left quietly.
——————
The pots and pans, as well as the stove and chopping boards, were all wiped clean by Wu Qian, giving the entire kitchen a brand new look.
[Ding——Moral value +20]
Wu Qian dusted off his hands and rushed to the next place to water the flowers with satisfaction.
Harvesting moral values ​​one crop after another, Wu Qian's mind became active again and he began to think about the issue of system income.
title_en: Chapter 9 Discovered Chapter 10 Wu Hou comes to the rescue
